title: Model Landscape Sentinel: prioritized watchlist & procurement signal matrix
creator: Marco Chen
description: Build a pragmatic, operational playbook and data product (Model Landscape Sentinel) that turns model market activity into prioritized signals for PM, Sales, and Partnerships. Deliverables: 1) a prioritized model watchlist with scoring across cost, latency, enterprise-ready features (RBAC, quantization, KMS compatibility), and ecosystem risk; 2) a procurement signal matrix that maps activity (new model releases, open-source license changes, partner OEM releases) to recommended actions (test-on-dedicated, pilot, engage vendor, degrade priority); 3) a lightweight dashboard spec for Console and a webhook schema to notify Sales/SEs when a model crosses priority thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Watchlist exists as CSV and in Console mockup with at least 40 models scored
Scoring rubric documented (latency, cost-index, enterprise-compat, API stability) and validated with 3 internal stakeholders
Procurement signal matrix includes 6 signal types with clear action mappings
Webhook schema drafted and sample payloads provided to GTM team
Handoff doc to Engineering (ENG-2713) and Solutions (SE playbook) completed
updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff. Reviewed existing PM watchlists and noted duplication with PM-51720; decided to consolidate under new 'Landscape Sentinel' project.

2025-02-20: Defined initial scoring axes during product sync: latency headroom, per-token cost delta vs base, feature parity (streaming, function-calls), deployment compatibility (quantized variants, containerized), and ecosystem velocity (release cadence).
2025-02-26: UX session with Design -> created two Console mock variations (table-first, timeline-first). Design recommended table-first for GTM triggers.

2025-03-03: Data availability review with Infra: Console telemetry can surface model usage trends and latency percentiles; need ENG work (ENG-2836) to surface CVE/license-change events from model catalogs.
2025-03-08: Scoring rubric trial run on 10 models; flagged weighting bias toward latency. Revised weights after feedback from Reliability and Solutions.
2025-03-11: Built sample webhook payloads and shared with Sales Ops; Sales asked for 'procurement urgency' flag and suggested SLA-styled action windows (24h pilot, 1 week deeper validation).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: deep content enrichment (automated evals, legal license parsing) is valuable but will push timeline. Scope to MLP: scoring + signal matrix + webhook; defer full automated evals to follow-up epics.
Next steps: finalize rubric by 2025-03-15, run full scoring pass across 40 candidate models by 2025-03-18, circulate to Sales for pilot read-in.
Risk: external model ecosystem changes (license re-licensing, forked weights) produce noisy signals — plan to add human-in-the-loop verification for 'high severity' flags.
